title: Range Sort Query
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 8 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 2\times 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 2\times 10^5; 1 \leq X \leq N; (P_1,P_2,\ldots,P_N) is a permutation of (1,2,\ldots,N).; 1 \leq C_i \leq 2; 1 \leq L_i \leq R_i \leq N; All values in input are integers.
